blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: The development of biomedical vision-language models (VLMs) with contrastive image-text pretraining has been driven by scaling to increasingly large and diverse image-text datasets. Beyond scaling, further progress can come from learning richer representations from existing data. We hypothesize that the structure of scientific literature itself provides an additional source of supervision: figures, panels, captions, and accompanying article text encode rich relationships across modalities. Yet, treating these as independent image-text pairs overlooks their relationships. To address this limitation, we incorporate these structural relationships into contrastive image-text supervision. We preserve exact image-text matches while introducing weaker positive supervision for related pairs, such as a panel and the caption of a sibling panel. We upweight cross-article negatives of the same content type to encourage finer discrimination. We also enrich panel descriptions using visual content, original figure captions, and mentioning paragraphs. Pairing panels with these descriptions and whole figures with their original captions yields Loom52M, a dataset of 52.4 million image-text pairs spanning scientific charts and biomedical images. Using Loom52M, BioLoom (DFN-2B) achieves 56.82% domain-balanced mean accuracy across 67 zero-shot classification tasks from 43 datasets in 10 domains, compared with 48.77% for MedPMC-CLIP. On BioLoomBench with concise captions and BioMedFlickr, it achieves bidirectional mean Recall@1 of 63.20% and 10.59%, versus 46.37% and 7.55% for the respective strongest evaluated baselines, BiomedCLIP and MedPMC-CLIP. Code, datasets, benchmarks, and models are available at https://bioloom-clip.github.io/.
blocks.zh: 生物医学视觉语言模型(VLMs)的开发具有对比性图像文本预训功能,其驱动力是规模化到日益庞大和多样化的图像文本数据集. 除了扩大规模之外,从现有数据中学习更丰富的表述可以取得进一步的进展。 我们假设,科学文献的结构本身提供了额外的监督来源:数字、面板、标题以及随附的文章文本将各种模式之间的丰富关系编码。 然而,将这些作为独立的图像文本对对待忽略了它们之间的关系。 为了消除这一局限性,我们将这些结构关系纳入反向图像文本监督。 我们保留准确的图像文本匹配,同时对相关对子引入更弱的正向监督,例如一个面板和一个兄弟姐妹面板的字幕. 为了鼓励更细微的歧视,我们增加同一内容类型的交叉文章负面内容。 我们还利用视觉内容、原始图表标题和提及段落来丰富小组说明。 与这些描述和整体数字对齐的面板与原始标题对齐的Loom52M,该数据集有5 240万个图像文本对,横跨科学图表和生物医学图像。 使用Loom52M,BioLoom(DFN-2B)在来自10个域的43个数据集的67个零发分级任务中实现了56.82%的域-平衡平均精度,而MedPMC-CLIP则为48.77%. 在BioLoom Bench上,BiomedCLIP和MedPMC-CLIP分别实现了63.20%和10.59%的双向平均召回率。 代码、数据集、基准和模型见https://bioloom-clip.github.io/。

blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Figure 1 : Zero-shot classification accuracy (%) across 10 domains (43 datasets, 67 tasks). BioLoom has the highest domain-balanced mean accuracy (56.82%) among the evaluated biomedical models .
blocks.zh: 图1:10个领域零镜头分类精度(%)(43个数据集,67个任务). BioLoom在评估的生物医学模型中拥有最高域平衡平均精度(56.82%)。

blocks.en: The success of vision-language models (VLMs) in general domains has sparked growing interest in developing biomedical embedding models that learn shared representations of images and text across diverse biomedical disciplines. By mapping images and their textual descriptions into a common representation space, these models enable cross-modal retrieval, connecting visual findings with large-scale scientific literature and clinical databases. This is particularly valuable in biomedicine, where images across modalities such as radiology, histopathology, and microscopy capture biological phenomena at multiple scales .
blocks.zh: 视觉语言模型(VLMs)在一般领域的成功引起了人们日益关注开发生物医学嵌入模型,学习不同生物医学学科对图像和文字的共同表述。 通过将图像及其文字描述映射到一个共同的表示空间,这些模型可以实现跨模式检索,将视觉发现与大规模科学文献和临床数据库相接. 这在生物医学中特别有价值,因为放射学、组织病理学和显微镜等不同模式的图像以多种尺度捕捉生物现象。

blocks.en:
To this end, scientific literature has emerged as a source of large-scale biomedical image-text supervision for both pretraining and post-training [ zhang2023biomedclipmultimodalbiomedicalfoundation , lozano2025biomedica ] . Recent work improves panel-caption alignment, enriches captions with article context, and introduces hierarchical supervision [ lin2023pmcclipcontrastivelanguageimagepretraining , kim2026medpmc , sun2025tokenswastedleveraginglong , yuan2026panel2patch ] . However, standard pairwise contrastive supervision does not distinguish exact matches from related but non-matching pairs.
Scientific articles contain multi-panel figures, figure-level captions, panel-specific descriptions, and textual discussions that collectively convey experimental context and scientific findings. These components are not independent: neighboring panels may present complementary measurements or controls, while panels across figures may describe related stages of an experiment.
blocks.zh:
为此,科学文献已成为对培训前和培训后进行大规模生物医学图像文本监督的来源。 最近的工作改进了面板-封面相接,丰富了与文章上下文相关的标题,并引入了分级监督[lin2023pmclipcontrative languageimpretraining. kim2026medpmc. sun2025tokenswasdledleveragelong., sun2026panel2patch]. 然而,标准对等对比性监督并不区分精确匹配与相邻而非相配对.
科学文章包含多板块数字,图级标题,具体板块描述,以及文字讨论,共同传达实验背景和科学结论. 这些组件不独立:相邻的面板可以提出互补的测量或控制,而跨数字的面板可以描述实验的相关阶段.

blocks.en: These relationships offer guidance on how each image-text pair should contribute to training. Building on these cues, we introduce BioLoom, a biomedical vision-language model that uses figure and article relationships for contrastive learning. BioLoom achieves strong zero-shot classification performance across ten biomedical domains (Fig. 1 ).
blocks.zh: 这些关系为每个图像文本组合如何促进培训提供了指导。 基于这些提示,我们引入了BioLoom,一种生物医学视觉语言模型,利用图和文章关系进行对比学习. BioLoom在10个生物医学领域(图1)实现了强烈的零发分级性能.

blocks.en: Figure 2 : Semi-positive image-text pairs within a whole figure. The anchor microscopy panel (i) shows tube formation, while the sibling chart (h) reports capillary branch counts under the same experimental conditions. The chart caption provides complementary context for the anchor image. We treat this image-text pair as semi-positive rather than an exact match or a negative.
blocks.zh: 图2:整个图中的半正图像文本对. 主锚显微镜面板(一)显示管状形成,而双胞胎图(h)报告毛细分枝在相同的实验条件下进行计数. 图表标题为主锚图像提供了互补上下文. 我们把这个图像文本对当作半正反的,而不是精确的匹配或负.

blocks.en:
A key challenge in designing BioLoom is determining how different image-text relationships should contribute to training: related components should not all be treated as equivalent training examples.
The dedicated caption of a panel provides a direct semantic match, whereas the caption of a sibling panel or the whole figure may describe complementary aspects of the same experiment. For example, the anchor microscopy panel in Fig. 2 shows cellular morphology, while its sibling chart quantifies the observed changes.
blocks.zh:
设计BioLoom的一个关键挑战是确定不同图像-文本关系应如何促进培训:不应将相关组成部分都视为同等的培训实例。
一个面板的专用标题提供了直接的语义匹配,而一个兄弟姐妹面板或整个数字的字幕可以描述同一实验的互补方面. 例如,Fig. 2中的主锚显微镜面板显示出细胞形态,而它的兄弟姐妹图则对所观测到的变化进行量化.

blocks.en:
Panels from different figures within the same article may share experimental context, although their semantic relatedness may vary.
Panels from different articles may depict similar content types while describing unrelated biological findings. Treating all these relationships as either positive or negative pairs risks introducing noisy supervision: overly broad positive assignments can blur distinctions between visual concepts, while treating related components as negatives can penalize meaningful semantic relationships.
blocks.zh:
同一条款中不同数字的面板可能具有相同的实验背景,尽管其语义关联可能有所不同.
来自不同文章的小组可以描述相似的内容类型,同时描述不相关的生物学发现. 将所有这些关系视为正对或负对有引入吵闹监督的风险:过于宽泛的正对任务可以模糊视觉概念之间的区别,而将相干部分视为负对则会惩罚有意义的语义关系.

blocks.en: BioLoom addresses this challenge through two complementary objectives. The primary contrastive objective aligns exact image-caption pairs while excluding other pairs from the same article from its negative set. The relational objective provides weaker positive supervision between a panel image and captions of sibling panels or the whole figure, and upweights cross-article negatives of the same content type.
blocks.zh: BioLoom通过两个相辅相成的目标来应对这一挑战。 首要对比目标对准了精确的图像-封装对并同时将同篇文章中的其他对子从其负数集中排除出. 关系目标在面板图像和双人面板或整个数字的字幕之间提供较弱的正向监督,在同一类内容的交叉反面上增加加权。

blocks.en: To support this structure-aware training, we introduce a data restructuring and enrichment pipeline on top of the figure records in BIOMEDICA [ lozano2025biomedica ] . When captioning a panel in a figure, we use its visual content, the original figure caption, and article paragraphs that mention the figure. Each panel receives a visual description of visible content and a contextual caption that incorporates relevant article context. We pair the panel crops with these enriched descriptions and retain whole figures with their original captions. To prioritize biomedical visual content, we exclude the whole figures composed entirely of charts. We retain figures that combine biomedical images and charts, as the chart panels can provide quantitative context for the accompanying biomedical images. The resulting dataset, Loom52M, contains 52.4M image-text pairs spanning biomedical images and charts.
blocks.zh: 为了支持这种具有结构意识的培训,我们在BIOMEDICA[lozano2025biomedica]的数字记录之上引入了数据重组和浓缩管道。 在图中标注面板时,我们使用其视觉内容、原始图标和提及图的文章段落。 每个面板都获得可见内容的可视化描述和包含相关文章上下文的上下文. 我们把面板作物配上这些丰富的描述 并保留完整的数字 与原始标题。 为了优先考虑生物医学视觉内容,我们排除了完全由图表构成的全部数字. 我们保留了将生物医学图像和图表结合起来的数字,因为图表面板可以为附带的生物医学图像提供定量背景。 由此产生的数据集Loom52M包含52.4M图像文本对,横跨生物医学图像和图表.

blocks.en: We train BioLoom on Loom52M with a pretrained BioClinical ModernBERT text encoder and a ViT-L/14 vision encoder initialized either randomly or from DFN-2B. The DFN-2B-initialized variant achieves 56.82% domain-balanced mean accuracy across 67 zero-shot classification tasks from 43 datasets in 10 domains, compared with 48.77% for MedPMC-CLIP. We also introduce BioLoomBench, a retrieval benchmark of 15,000 biomedical and chart figures. BioLoom achieves bidirectional mean Recall@1 of 63.20% with concise captions on BioLoomBench and 10.59% on BioMedFlickr. We contribute:
blocks.zh: 我们在Loom52M上培训BioLoom,配备了经过预先训练的BioClinic ModernBERT文本编码器和ViT-L/14视觉编码器,无论是随机还是从DFN-2B初始化. DFN-2B-初始化的变体在来自10个域的43个数据集的67个零发分级任务中实现了56.82%的域-平衡平均精度,而MedPMC-CLIP则达到了48.77%. 我们还引入了BioLoom Bench,这是15,000生物医学和图表数字的检索基准。 BioLoom 实现双向平均回调@ 1, 63.20%, 并有关于 BioLoom Bench 和 10.59% BioMedFlickr的简洁标题 。 我们促进:

blocks.en: • Structure-aware image-text labeling. We label image-text pairs using article, figure, and panel relationships. • Revised contrastive objective. We combine exact-pair and semi-positive alignment with related-pair masking and same-content-type hard-negative weighting. • Training data. We construct Loom52M with 52.4M pairs, matching whole figures with original captions and panels with enriched descriptions. • Models and evaluation. BioLoom achieves strong performance in biomedical classification and image-text retrieval. We introduce BioLoomBench for retrieval evaluation across biomedical images, charts, and diagrams, and will release our dataset, models, and benchmarks.
blocks.zh: • 结构意识图像文字标签。 我们用文章、图和面板关系标记图像文本对。 • 订正对比性目标。 我们结合了精确的pair和半正比配合 与相关的pair 遮掩和相同内容类型的硬负重。 • 培训数据。 我们用52.4M的对子建造了Loom52M,将整幅数字与原字幕和面板相匹配,并附有丰富的描述. • 模式和评价。 BioLoom在生物医学分类和图像文本检索方面实现了强效. 我们将介绍BioLoom Bench, 用于生物医学图像、图表和图表的检索评估, 并将发布我们的数据集、模型和基准。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Biomedical image-text datasets and curation. Clinical images, reports, and scientific articles support biomedical AI training. Clinical collections provide chest radiographs with reports or diagnostic labels [ demnerfushman2016preparing , johnson2019mimiccxr , wang2017chestxray8 , irvin2019chexpert , bustos2020padchest , nguyen2022vindrcxr ] , while Quilt-1M focuses on pathology, mainly using educational videos and other public sources [ ikezogwo2023quilt ] . Scientific articles support large-scale, multi-domain collections such as PMC-15M and BIOMEDICA [ zhang2023biomedclipmultimodalbiomedicalfoundation , lozano2025biomedica ] . ROCO pairs radiology images with captions and concepts [ pelka2018roco ] ; MedICaT adds in-text references and subfigure-subcaption annotations for a subset of figures [ subramanian2020medicat ] . Open-PMC and MedPMC improve pair quality through image filtering and figure separation [ baghbanzadeh2025openpmc , kim2026medpmc ] . Original captions may still omit panel-specific details. We construct Loom52M to link whole figures with panels and enrich descriptions using visible content, original captions, and mentioning paragraphs.
blocks.zh: 生物医学影像-文字数据集与目录. 临床图像,报告和科学文章支持生物医学AI培训. 临床收藏为胸腔放射图提供了报告或诊断标签[demnerfushman2016 preparating., Johnson2019miccxr., wang2017chestxray8. irvin2019ch 专家 Busos2020padchest. nguyen2022vindrcxr],而Quilt-1M则主要使用教育视频和其他公共来源[ikezogwo2023quilt]. 科学文章支持PMC-15M和BIOMEDICA等大型多领域收藏[zhang2023biomedclip多模式生物医学奠基. lozano2025biomedica]. ROCO将放射学图像与标题和概念相配 [pelka2018roco]; MedICaT为一子集数字[subramanian2020medicat]添加了文字引用和子图分集说明. Open-PMC和MedPMC通过图像过滤和数字分离提高配对质量[baghbanzadeh2025openpmc., kim2026medpmc]. 原始标题可能仍然会省略特定面板的细节 。 我们构建了Loom52M,将整个数字与面板相连接,并使用可见内容、原始标题和提及段落来丰富描述。

blocks.en: Biomedical vision-language learning. CLIP, ALIGN, and OpenCLIP learn shared image-text representations through large-scale contrastive training [ radford2021clip , jia2021align , cherti2023reproduciblescalinglawscontrastive ] . SigLIP uses a pairwise sigmoid loss [ zhai2023siglip ] , while CoCa adds caption generation [ yu2022cocacontrastivecaptionersimagetext ] . ALBEF, BLIP, and BLIP-2 explore multimodal fusion and generation [ li2021albef , li2022blip , li2023blip2 ] ; Long-CLIP and LoTLIP support longer text [ zhang2024longclip , wu2024lotlip ] . Biomedical models learn global or local alignment from radiology images and reports [ pmlr-v182-zhang22a , huang2021gloria , boecking2022making , mueller2022lovt , wang2022mgca ] , while MedCLIP uses medical semantics beyond original pairings [ wang2022medclip ] . Other radiology studies incorporate temporal information [ bannur2023biovilt ] , scale chest X-ray pretraining [ you2023cxrclip ] , or introduce medical knowledge [ wu2023medklip , zhang2023kad ] . PMC-CLIP, BiomedCLIP, and BIOMEDICA models extend coverage across biomedical domains using scientific image-caption pairs [ lin2023pmcclipcontrastivelanguageimagepretraining , zhang2023biomedclipmultimodalbiomedicalfoundation , lozano2025biomedica ] . Alongside broader domain coverage, studies have improved text supervision and pair quality. BMC-LongCLIP enriches captions with article context [ sun2025tokenswastedleveraginglong ] , while MedPMC-CLIP uses image filtering, panel separation, and text alignment [ kim2026medpmc ] . Another line of work studies finer image-text correspondences by aligning image patches or regions with text or learning from related image-text groups [ yao2022filip , zeng2022xvlm , zhong2022regionclip , javed2024cplip ] . For scientific figures, Panel2Patch constructs supervision at the figure, panel, and region levels [ yuan2026panel2patch ] , while FigEx2 detects panels and generates captions [ song2026figex2 ] . Our approach uses figure and article relationships to guide contrastive learning beyond individual image-text pairs.

blocks.en: To support this training objective, we construct Loom52M with linked article, figure, and panel records from BIOMEDICA [ lozano2025biomedica ] . We provide Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite with the whole figure, its original caption, and relevant article paragraphs. The model uses these inputs to locate panels and generate their descriptions through cross-component caption enrichment. The inputs and outputs follow.
blocks.zh: 为了支持这一培训目标,我们用BIOMEDICA[lozano2025biomedica]的相关文章、图和面板记录构建了Loom52M。 我们向双子座3.5 Flash-Lite 提供整个图、其原始标题和相关的文章段落。 该模型利用这些投入来定位面板并通过交叉组件标题浓缩生成其描述. 投入和产出如下。

blocks.en: Input: the whole figure. Of the retained whole figures in Loom52M, 57.68% contain at least two extracted panels. We provide the whole figure for panel localization and description. This gives the annotation model access to each panel and its surrounding figure context.
blocks.zh: 输入:全图. 在Loom52M保留的全部数字中,57.68%包含至少两个取出面板. 我们提供整个数字 用于面板定位和描述。 这使得注释模型可以访问每个面板及其周围的数字上下文.

blocks.en: Input: the original figure caption. We provide the full original caption as context for panel annotation. It supplies information about the figure and its constituent panels, such as experimental conditions and panel references.
blocks.zh: 输入:原图标题. 我们提供完整的原始标题作为小组说明的背景。 它提供有关该数字及其组成小组的资料,例如实验条件和小组参考。

blocks.en: Input: figure mentions in the article. We additionally provide up to two paragraphs from the article body that mention the figure. These paragraphs supply context that may not be available from the image or caption alone.
blocks.zh: 输入:数字在文章中提及。 此外,我们还从文章机构提供了最多两段提到该数字。 这些段落提供了图像或标题中可能无法提供的上下文。

blocks.en: Output: panel bounding boxes. The model returns panel boxes as [ y min , x min , y max , x max ] [y_{\min},x_{\min},y_{\max},x_{\max}] , normalized to [ 0 , 1000 ] [0,1000] . We convert to pixels and crop each panel.
blocks.zh: 输出:面板边框。 模型返回面板框为 [y min, x min, y max max , x max max] , 规范为 [0, 1000] [0 1100] 。 我们转换成像素,并收割每个面板。

blocks.en: Output: panel descriptions. For each panel, the model generates two complementary text fields. The visual description summarizes visible content only. The contextual caption combines this content with information from the original caption and mentioning paragraphs. Each field contains one or two sentences, and the prompt discourages repetition between them. We concatenate the two fields and pair the resulting text with the panel crop. We also retain whole-figure samples, pairing each uncropped image with its original caption. Supp. A provides the full prompt. Supp. K details annotation and pretraining costs.
blocks.zh: 产出:面板说明。 对于每个面板,模型产生两个互补的文本字段. 视觉描述只总结出可见的内容. 背景标题将这一内容与原标题所提供的信息相合并并提及段落。 每个字段包含一到两句子,即时会阻止它们之间的重复. 我们把两个字段拼接起来,然后把结果的文字同面板作物相配. 我们还保留了完整的图样,将每个未剪接的图像与原始标题相配. 苏普。 A提供全速 K详细列出了注释和培训前费用。

blocks.en: Filtering and dataset construction. We remove over 10.8M whole figures whose annotated panels consist entirely of charts, together with their panel crops, to focus training on biomedical visual content. We retain figures that mix biomedical images and charts, including their chart panels, to preserve potentially related visual observations within each figure. To ensure valid training pairs, we also discard records with unreadable images or empty paired text. We retain article and figure IDs to preserve the links between articles, whole figures, and panels for structure-aware training. The constructed dataset contains 13.1M whole-figure pairs and 39.3M panel pairs. We use the full 52.4M-pair training dataset for pretraining.
blocks.zh: 过滤和数据集构建。 我们删除了10.8M以上的全部数字,这些数字的注解面板完全由图表及其面板作物组成,以侧重于生物医学视觉内容的培训。 我们保留了混合生物医学图像和图表的数字,包括其图表面板,以保存每个图中可能相关的视觉观测。 为了确保有效的训练配对,我们也丢弃带有无法读取的图像或空配对文本的记录. 我们保留文章和图表标识,以保持文章、整张数字和具有结构意识的培训面板之间的联系。 所构建的数据集包含有13.1M整图对和39.3M面板对. 我们使用完整的52.4M派训练数据集进行预训.

blocks.en: Comparison with existing datasets. Tab. 1 compares dataset scale, image views, text supervision, and visual coverage. Beyond whole figures paired with original captions, Loom52M provides finer-grained, richer supervision through panel-level visual descriptions and contextual captions. Its 52.4M pairs preserve article–figure–panel links for structure-aware learning. Retaining charts in mixed figures supports joint learning and text-based retrieval of biomedical images and scientific charts.
blocks.zh: 与现有数据集进行比较. Tab. 1比较了数据集尺度,图像视图,文本监督,以及视觉覆盖. Loom52M通过面板级的视觉描述和背景描述提供更精细更丰富的监督。 它的52.4M对保存了文章-图-平面链接,用于结构意识学习. 在混合数字中保留图表支持生物医学图像和科学图的联合学习和以文字为基础的检索。

blocks.en: 3.4 Pretraining
blocks.zh: 3.4 预训

blocks.en: BioLoom uses the CLIP dual-encoder architecture [ radford2021clip ] , with a ViT-L/14 vision encoder [ dosovitskiy2021image ] and a BioClinical ModernBERT text encoder [ sounack2025bioclinicalmodernbert ] . By default, the vision encoder is randomly initialized, while the text encoder uses weights pretrained on biomedical literature and clinical text. Both encoders are jointly trained on all 52.4M Loom52M image-text pairs for 10 epochs using Eq. 6 . A second variant initializes the vision encoder from DFN-2B-pretrained ViT-L/14 [ fang2024data ] , retaining the same text initialization. Sec. 4.1 provides implementation details.
blocks.zh: BioLoom使用CLIP双相编码器架构[radford2021clip],有ViT-L/14视觉编码器[dosovitskiy2021image]和生化临床现代BERT文本编码器[sounack2025生化现代]. 默认情况下,视觉编码器是随机初始化的,而文本编码器则在生物医学文献和临床文本上使用预先被训练过的重量. 两个编码器共同培训了所有52.4M Loom52M图像文本配对,用于使用Eq. 6的10个纪元. 第二个变体从DFN-2B-被预先训练的VIT-L/14[fang2024data]初始化了视觉编码器,保留了相同的文本初始化. 第4.1条提供了实施细节。

blocks.en: 4.1 Datasets, evaluation, and implementation
blocks.zh: 4.1 数据集、评价和执行情况

blocks.en: Datasets. For biomedical transfer evaluation, we assemble 43 public datasets used in BIOMEDICA [ lozano2025biomedica ] , MedPMC [ kim2026medpmc ] , and other public benchmarks, including evaluation sets released in 2025 and 2026. This zero-shot benchmark covers 67 tasks across 10 biomedical domains. Supp. C details datasets, targets, and evaluation splits. For broader retrieval evaluation, we construct BioLoomBench from whole figures in papers released in 2026 through bioRxiv [ sever2019biorxiv ] and the Europe PMC Open Access subset [ europepmc2015 ] . It contains 15,000 figures across 15 biomedical domains, with 1,000 per domain, covering biological images, mixed biological images and charts, diagrams, and chart-only figures. It includes single-panel and multi-panel figures, each paired with a concise visual caption and its original caption. Supp. B provides details. We do not train on this benchmark. We also evaluate on the publicly available BioMedFlickr test set of 7,185 image-caption pairs [ lozano2025biomedica ] .
blocks.zh: 数据集. 为了进行生物医学转移评价,我们收集了43个公共数据集,用于BIOMEDICA [lozano2025biomedica],MedPMC [kim2026medpmc],以及其他公共基准,包括2025年和2026年发布的评价数据集. 这一零射入基准涵盖10个生物医学领域的67项任务。 苏普。 C详细列出了数据集、目标和评价划分。 为了进行更广泛的检索评价,我们从2026年发表的论文中通过BioRxiv[断出2019biorxiv]和欧洲PMC开放访问子集[Europepmc2015]构建出整个数字. 它包含15个生物医学领域的15 000个数字,每个域有1 000个,包括生物图像、生物图像和图表、图表和仅用图表的数字。 它包括了单平面和多平面图,每平面图有简洁的可视化标题及其原始标题. 苏普。 B提供了细节。 我们不对这一基准进行培训。 我们还评估了公开的BioMedFlickr测试集,共7,185个图像封装对[lozano2025biomedica].

blocks.en: Evaluation protocols. Following BIOMEDICA [ lozano2025biomedica ] , we average normalized embeddings of two equivalent prompts per class to form a prototype and classify images by cosine similarity. We report accuracy averaged over tasks within datasets, datasets within domains, and the 10 domains equally. Supp. C details prompts and aggregation; Supp. E discusses Macro-F1 and one-vs-rest AUC. We evaluate bidirectional retrieval on BioLoomBench and BioMedFlickr using Recall@ K K for K ∈ { 1 , 10 , 100 } K\in\{1,10,100\} . BioLoomBench results are reported separately for concise and original captions. For BioMedFlickr, rows with identical released captions form one relevant set. Supp. F defines this revised protocol and reports one-to-one retrieval results. Supp. D reports bootstrap confidence intervals.

blocks.en: Implementation details. We use a ViT-L/14 vision encoder [ dosovitskiy2021image ] at 224 × 224 224\times 224 resolution and a pretrained BioClinical ModernBERT text encoder [ sounack2025bioclinicalmodernbert ] , with a maximum text length of 512 tokens. BioLoom (Scratch) randomly initializes the vision encoder; BioLoom (DFN-2B) uses DFN-2B ViT-L/14 weights [ fang2024data ] . Both use the same pretrained text encoder. Learning rates are 5 × 10 − 4 5\times 10^{-4} for random initialization and 1 × 10 − 4 1\times 10^{-4} for DFN-2B initialization. We train for 10 epochs with the masked contrastive and relation losses on eight H200 GPUs with a global batch size of 1,536. Same-figure pairs are split into groups of at most three and shuffled through a buffer to form batches; whole-figure and panel pairs both count toward this limit. Each GPU computes losses for local anchors against candidates gathered across all GPUs. All anchors contribute to the main loss; only those with semi-positive candidates contribute to the relation loss. We use AdamW with ( β 1 , β 2 ) = ( 0.9 , 0.95 ) (\beta_{1},\beta_{2})=(0.9,0.95) , 2,000 warm-up steps, cosine decay, and mixed precision. The defaults are 0.05 for the relation loss and 1.1 for same-content-type hard negatives.

blocks.en: 4.2 Main Evaluation
blocks.zh: 4.2 主要评价

blocks.en: Comparison with state-of-the-art methods. Tabs. 3 , 3 , and 4 summarize zero-shot classification and bidirectional image-text retrieval results. We also evaluate the released Panel2Patch ViT-L/14 checkpoint [ yuan2026panel2patch ] , initialized from BMC-CLIP, under the same protocols.
blocks.zh: 与最先进的方法比较. Tabs. 3, 3, 和 4 总结了零镜头分类和双向图像文本检索结果. 我们还评估了根据同一协议从BMC-CLIP初始化的Getal2Patch ViT-L/14检查站。

blocks.en: BioLoom (Scratch) achieves 52.89% domain-balanced zero-shot mean accuracy, exceeding MedPMC-CLIP by 4.12 percentage points. It outperforms the evaluated baselines on BioLoomBench with both caption views: image-to-text (I2T) and text-to-image (T2I) R@1 are 61.93% and 52.33% with concise captions, and 75.91% and 74.22% with original captions. On BioMedFlickr, its I2T R@1 exceeds MedPMC-CLIP (8.00% versus 5.94%), while T2I R@1 remains slightly lower (8.84% versus 9.16%). Panel2Patch performs strongly in microscopy and radiology but transfers unevenly across domains. Its focus on localized correspondences may transfer less effectively to BioLoomBench, where caption matching can require biomedical image and chart information.
blocks.zh: BioLoom (Scratch) 实现52.89%域相平衡的零射入平均值精度,超过MedPMC-CLIP4.12个百分点. 它比BioLoom Bench上评估的基线要好,其标题视图为:图像对文本(I2T)和文本对图像(T2I)R@1为61.93%和52.33%为简明标题,75.91%和74.22%为原始标题。 在BioMedFlickr上,它的I2T R@1超过了MedPMC-CLIP(8.00 %对5.94%),而T2I R@1仍然略低(8.84%对9.16%). 专题小组2 补丁在显微镜和放射学方面表现强劲,但在不同领域之间的转移不均衡。 它专注于本地化的通信可能不太有效地转移到BioLoom Bench,在那里,字幕匹配可以需要生物医学图像和图表信息.

blocks.en: DFN-2B initialization further improves classification and retrieval. BioLoom (DFN-2B) reaches 56.82% domain-balanced zero-shot mean accuracy, 3.93 percentage points above Scratch, and exceeds MedPMC-CLIP in all ten domains. BioLoomBench I2T and T2I R@1 reach 66.81% and 59.59% with concise captions, with gains also observed for original captions. Supp. H reports MMBU results. Supp. I further demonstrates the strong performance of BioLoom in cross-level image-text retrieval. On BioMedFlickr benchmark, I2T and T2I R@1 reach 9.73% and 11.45%, respectively.
blocks.zh: DFN-2B初始化进一步改善了分类和检索. BioLoom (DFN-2B) 达到56.82%的域平衡零射入中精度,比Scratch高3.93个百分点,在所有10个域都超过了MedPMC-CLIP. BioLoom Bench I2T和T2I R@1达到66.81%和59.59%,带有简洁的字幕,原始字幕也有增益。 苏普。 H报告MMBU结果. 苏普。 我进一步展示了BioLoom在跨层图像文本检索中的强效表现. 在BioMedFlickr基准上,I2T和T2I R@1分别达到9.73%和11.45%.

blocks.en: Linear probing. To assess visual transferability, we linearly probe frozen vision encoders on the 12 MedMNIST 2D datasets [ yang2023medmnist ] ( Supp. G ). Fig. 4 reports test accuracy and Macro-F1 averaged equally across datasets. BioLoom (Scratch) achieves 84.45% accuracy and 72.20% Macro-F1, comparable to ImageNet-21k-pretrained ViT-L/16 (84.42% and 72.36%). BioLoom is pretrained for image-text matching, whereas classification pretraining is more closely aligned with linear probing. It also exceeds DINOv2 [ oquab2024dinov2 ] (83.31% accuracy and 70.15% Macro-F1). These results suggest that image-text pretraining on Loom52M can learn transferable features from a randomly initialized vision encoder.
blocks.zh: 线性探测. 为了评估可视性,我们在12个MedMNIST 2D数据集上线性地探测了被冻结的视觉编码器[yang2023medmnist] (Supp. G. 图4报告测试准确度和Macro-F1在数据集中的平均值相同。 BioLoom(Scratch)实现84.45%的精度和72.20%的Macro-F1,可与ImageNet-21k-pressed Vit-L/16(84.42%和72.36%)相比. BioLoom为图像文本匹配而预训,而分类预训则更紧密地与线性测试相配合. 它也超过了DINOv2 [oquab2024dinov2] (83.31%的精度和70.15%的宏-F1). 这些结果表明,Loom52M上的图像文本预训可以从随机初始化的视觉编码器中学习可转移的特性.
